hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]]; then dart format "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == */lib/*.dart ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|/lib/.*||')" && flutter analyze --no-pub 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.ts ]] && [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == */functions/* ]]; then cd "$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH | sed 's|/functions/.*|/functions|')" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -10 || true; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf|--force|--no-verify)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: dangerous command detected'; exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{32,}|firebase-adminsdk)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: potential secret detected in content'; exit 2; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(palette|design|couleur|theme|maquette)'; then echo 'CONTEXT: palette officielle Kilimandjaro — Vert forêt #1a3a20 (fond), Vert clair #4a9e58 (succès/CTA), Or soleil #f0c040 (titres/coins), Or chaud #e8a020, Bois #c8843a (tuiles), Bois foncé #7c4e1e, Ivoire #f5ead0 (texte), Rouge #c0392b (erreur). Typos: Bebas Neue (titres), Playfair Display (mots), Crimson Pro (texte). Voir docs/maquette.pdf p.2.'; fi
